basis: The chart shows a steady decline in the District Heating Demand Index from 24.0 in 2005 to 10.0 in 2015, representing a full-period drop of 14.0 units. This represents a ~58% reduction over the decade. While no explicit numeric threshold is printed on the chart, a change of this magnitude (nearly halving the demand index) is visually and quantitatively significant enough to be characterized as a 'substantial change' rather than 'ordinary variation' in a monitoring context. The trend is consistent and monotonic, reinforcing the significance of the change.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up
